submitted.rationale: EQE increased steadily as Fe content went up: 0.0064% at Fe0.53 (idx 9), 0.136% at Fe0.81 (idx 2) and 0.194% at Fe0.85 (idx 0). Indices 0, 2 and 4 show the same XRD peaks, so they appear to be one phase. Only the relative intensity at Q=4.55 rises with Fe. The most Fe-rich end of the library therefore performs best, and idx 0 is the most Fe-rich composition.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE of 0.0064%, about 30x lower than the Fe-rich end. This is near the FeSbO4 composition.
Measured EQE of 0.136%, lower than idx 0 (0.194%).
EQE falls as Sb content rises, so these are expected to perform worse. None were measured.
